title: Iimpawu zeqonga
requiredTextNote: Ezinye iithegi zombhalo ziyafuneka kwaye zihlala zisebenza (ziboniswa zingasebenzi).
featuresWarning: Ukucima ezi ndlela kunokususa izakhono eziphambili zokubhala nolawulo.
largeSiteWarning: Le sayithi inamaphepha amaninzi. Ukwenziwa kwesakhelo kungathatha ixesha.
skeletonLargeSiteConfirm: Le sayithi inamaphepha angama-{count}. Ukwenza amathambo kunokuthatha ixesha kwaye kwenze ifayile enkulu. Uyaqhubeka?
addPageFeatureDescription: Ivumela ukwenza amaphepha amatsha ukusuka kwibha ephezulu, kwizenzo zolwandlalo, nakwizenzo zokukhangela imiyalelo.
deletePageFeatureDescription: Ivumela ukucima amaphepha ukusuka kwizenzo zephepha, kwizenzo zolwandlalo, nakwiinkqubo zolawulo ezinxulumeneyo.
outlineDesignerFeatureDescription: Ivula izixhobo zolwakhiwo lwesayithi, kuquka izenzo zolwandlalo kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo yoLwakhiwo.
styleGuideFeatureDescription: Ibonisa ukufikelela kwiSikhokelo seSitayile kwizixhobo zolawulo nakwizinqumlo zokukhangela imiyalelo.
insightsFeatureDescription: Ivula iiNgxelo kulawulo nakukhangelo lwemiyalelo ukuze imiboniso yohlalutyo nokuqonda ifumaneke.
siteManifestFeatureDescription: Ilawula amacandelo eeSetingi zeSayithi zeeNkcukacha, iiBhloko, kunye nolungiselelo loMhleli.
themeManifestFeatureDescription: Ivula icandelo leesetingi zeNkangeleko/zoMxholo kulawulo lwesayithi.
authorManifestFeatureDescription: Ivula iprofayile yombhali kunye neesetingi zemethadatha yombhali kulawulo lwesayithi.
seoManifestFeatureDescription: Ivula iisetingi zokuphucula injini yokukhangela nemethadatha kulawulo lwesayithi.
pageBreakFeatureDescription: Ibonisa ulawulo lokuhlela imethadatha yephepha njengesihloko, i-icon, imeko, iithegi, kunye nokutshixa.
addBlockFeatureDescription: Ibonisa isikhangeli seebhloko kwaye ivumela ukongeza iibhloko zomxholo ezintsha ngelixa uhlela.
popularGizmosFeatureDescription: Ibonisa icandelo leeBhloko ezithandwayo ngaphakathi kumkhethi weebhloko.
recentGizmosFeatureDescription: Ibonisa icandelo leeBhloko zakutsha nje ngaphakathi kumkhethi weebhloko.
contentMapFeatureDescription: Ibonisa iphaneli yemephu/yolwakhiwo lomxholo wephepha ngelixa uhlela umxholo.
viewSourceFeatureDescription: Ivula umboniso womthombo we-HTML wokuhlela ngqo uphawu lwephepha.
uploadMediaFeatureDescription: Ivula iinkqubo zokulayisha iifayile kunye nokufikelela kulawulo lwemidiya/lweefayile olunxulumeneyo.
onlineMediaFeatureDescription: Ivula udibaniso lwemidiya ye-intanethi kunye nemithombo yokukhangela imidiya ekude.
communityFeatureDescription: Ivula umxholo wokukhangela imiyalelo onxulumene noluntu kunye nezenzo ezijolise ekufikeleleni.
